authority.user_requirement: 漫画分镜和剧本分镜先确认画风、风格、宽高比、对标；主动了解目标模型优缺点及最新版本支持时长，再据此写提示词；中途换模型必须重新检索，作为死命令写入。
authority.publication_authority: Current explicit update request plus existing standing routine-maintenance PR self-check, merge and readback authorization.

implemented_gates: Confirmed medium, concrete style, exact aspect ratio and viewed benchmark before formal work; reuse existing confirmations.
Actual current primary-source model research and complete capability matrix with evidence/unknown labels before model-ready prompts.
Separate latest public version from the version/entry/tier/mode actually selected.
Verify per-mode single-generation duration/options separately from extensions and edited runtime.
Map capabilities and limitations to segment length, action density, inputs, control syntax and continuity.
Invalidate on model/version/tier/entry or capability-affecting mode switch; re-research even when switching back.
Refresh across sessions/dates or on update/conflict/new critical capability requirements; narrow same-session same-day reuse only with readable evidence.
Stop formal delivery on unresolved critical evidence gaps; no memory-based numeric defaults or unsupported control syntax.
Visible verification summary and source/time record; no automatic production on mere activation or analysis.
